body.title: Update the installed daemon and run the c2ba6fa6/s1 smoke
body.summary: Rebuild and update the installed daemon (maintenance update, then restart), then run Epic c2ba6fa6 Story s1's code review through the daemon's code-review RPC in the gated live test src/workflow/review-pipeline/__tests__/smoke-c2ba6fa6-s1.live.test.ts (INSRC_LIVE_TESTS=1), which writes docs/epics/chunked-review-pipeline-every-review-E202610198315a11f/S003/smoke-c2ba6fa6-s1.json with the run date, the installed daemon commit, the verdict and counts, and per dimension the chunk plan (chunk count, chars per chunk) and calls per stage. The review record itself is written by the daemon as today. The gate receives the result as a reported smoke pointing at the smoke record.
acceptanceChecks: The installed daemon runs the build containing t1-t8.
Epic c2ba6fa6 Story s1's code review completes on the installed daemon and records a verdict; anything else fails the smoke with the outcome and plan logged.
The smoke record holds the run date, daemon commit, verdict and counts, and per dimension the chunk plan and calls per stage.

tests.name: src/workflow/review-pipeline/__tests__/smoke-c2ba6fa6-s1.live.test.ts: 'Epic c2ba6fa6 Story s1's code review completes on the installed daemon, records a verdict, and writes the chunk plan and calls per stage to the smoke record'
